rules.justification: Exact (rule SMM-INIT-BIT; docs/NUMERICAL_VALIDATION.md): the case reads the release-cached current position, the stable time step, the displacement and the releases after static solves with the Eigen sparse solver (bit-identical SparseLU translation, Eigen cache sizes pinned, D-050) and after Dirichlet functor writes; the port replicates the operation order (the rule of fixtures/model/smm). crates/akantu-solid/tests/smm_init_solver_ud352.rs compares every value bitwise: in upstream-compat mode (SmmUpstreamCompat::init_solver_resets_current_position) all nine orderings, in the default all except the current position and stable time step of B1 and E1 (UD-352, D-064), which are checked against independent values (X + u from the oracle's own X and u; E0's position and time step).
rules.evidence: pinned x86_64 oracle (strict, Eigen cache sizes 16384/524288/524288, OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=Haswell, sparse solver eigen, per the manifest), three identical runs; replay bitwise on x86_64 Linux (image akantu-rs-mpi:dev) and macOS/aarch64; re-run by an independent review: smm_init_solver_ud352.rs 6/6 pass, the oracle replay bitwise in both modes
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
